Vik corrected the repeated reuse of one Task for further work: "When that happens it needs to become a parent and have child subtasks so we can see each time we need to add a new one for mor testing".

When an existing Manifest Task expands into successive repairs, tests or experiments, retain its identity as a parent and create distinct child Tasks before executing the additional work. Each completed round keeps its own outcome, evidence and completion state. A negative completed investigation does not satisfy product acceptance. Report the actual next child card instead of repeatedly appending work to the same leaf.

W1.8.4.4 is now the open parent for successive ordinary-retrieval repair and verification rounds. W1.8.4.4.1 through .8 retrospectively record eight completed rounds with evidence; .2/.5/.8 preserve the negative v1/v2/v3 measurements. W1.8.4.4.9 is the open, undecomposed next Task for retained-trace retrieval-round-trip follow-through. Implementation phase, prior identities, original acceptance criteria and prerequisite semantics are preserved. V3 input remains 402423 (1.6142 times baseline); input/time and strict completeness remain unaccepted. This structure correction runs no new product repair or experiment.

The eight rounds are initial host repair acceptance; v1 binding measurement; discovery and named-anchor repair; its host activation; v2 binding measurement; input-type priority and short-reference implementation; its host activation; and v3 binding measurement. Backfilled cards explicitly identify retrospective creation. This correction does not pretend they existed before execution. All 16 selected evidence paths exist; all 42 original Task identities and non-structural facts are preserved outside the corrected parent. A read-only Luna/medium worker supported the historical mapping; the primary dropped unsupported suggested paths and adopted the bounded evidence mapping.

Evidence: /Users/brummerv/loci/.manifest/objectives/obj_47c29425d32907d2bde961f1fd313970.json; .scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/task-structure-{correction,evidence,readback,legacy-details}.{md,json} (use the actual paths listed in the correction artifact). Negative historical observations and thresholds remain unchanged.
